newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE MONEY RATES MIXED IN ACTIVE TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE MONEY RATES MIXED IN ACTIVE TRADE.

text.p: Short-term interest rates on Zimbabwe's money market were quoted mixed in active trade on Thursday.
"There was a lot of activity this morning. People were buying paper in anticipation of a drop in the rates after today's (weekly) Treasury bill tender," one dealer said.
He said Treasury bills were indicated unchanged at 17.75 percent and NCD bills maturing after 30, 60 and 90 days were also quoted stable at 19.50 percent (buying) and 18.25 percent (selling).
Bankers acceptances were firmer at 18.50 percent from 18.25 (buying) but steady at 17.75 percent (selling), while call money shed half a percentage point to 18 percent.
The market opened in surplus of Z$226.1 million, up from Z$101.8 million the previous day.
